verdict.rationale: Graphite ships an official `gt` CLI with install docs (Homebrew/npm), a command reference (e.g. `gt absorb` with `--dry-run`), and configuration docs. GT MCP exposes stacked-PR creation to AI agents, which ties the CLI to agentic workflows, and several community users report using the CLI daily. missing for 10: documented machine-readable/non-interactive output modes for agent scripting (e.g. JSON output; `gt config` is interactive).
